sections.compose_hint: Write your message and choose who should receive it.
sections.recipients_hint: Select one or more groups. Emails are deduplicated automatically.

placeholders.subject: Email subject line
placeholders.custom_emails: Type an email and press Enter to add
placeholders.title: e.g. Spring website offer
placeholders.goal: e.g. Book discovery calls for our new website package

hints.all_subscribers: Sends to every non-blocked newsletter subscriber.
hints.all_contacts: Sends to every CRM contact that has an email address.
hints.all_contact_forms: Sends to every non-blocked inquiry that has an email address.
hints.all_leads: Sends to every non-blocked lead that has an email address.
hints.lead_tags: Check one or more tags to include every lead with those tags, such as Cold and Warm. Leads in more than one selected tag are only sent once.
hints.custom_emails: Add any additional email addresses not listed above. Type an email and press Enter.
hints.send_warning: Emails are queued and sent in the background. This action cannot be undone.
hints.send_as_marketing: Create a marketing campaign from this content and queue it after saving.
hints.all_audiences: Subscribers, contacts, and inquiries with valid email addresses.

messages.send_failed: Failed to send the email. Please check your mail configuration and try again.

validation.fix_errors: Please fix the following errors and try again.
validation.select_recipients: Select at least one recipient group or add custom emails.
validation.no_recipients: No valid email addresses were found for the selected recipients.
validation.subject_too_long: The subject may not be greater than 255 characters.
validation.permission_required: You do not have permission to send marketing emails.
validation.group_required: Select an existing campaign or enter a title and goal for a new one.

groups.hint: Group this email or WhatsApp send under a campaign with a title and a goal.
groups.goal_hint: Describe what this campaign should achieve. AI uses this to write the email.
groups.form_hint: Give the campaign a title and a goal, then send email or WhatsApp from it.
groups.empty: No campaigns yet. Create one to group email and WhatsApp sends.
groups.in_use: This campaign cannot be deleted because it already has email or WhatsApp sends.

missing.heading: This campaign is missing:
missing.title: A campaign title
missing.sends: At least one email or WhatsApp send
missing.email: No email has been sent yet
missing.whatsapp: No WhatsApp message has been sent yet

ai.tooltip: Write the subject and message from the campaign goal
ai.banner_hint: Uses the campaign title and goal to draft the subject and message.
ai.prompt_label: Anything else the email should mention?
ai.prompt_placeholder: Optional. e.g. Mention the spring discount and a Friday deadline.
ai.applied: The subject and message were filled. Review them before sending.
ai.overwrite: This will replace the current subject and message. Continue?
ai.group_required: Select or create a campaign with a title and goal first.
ai.goal_required: Add a campaign goal so the AI knows what to write.
